name: corrobo
title_zh: 重试一次就多扣一笔款？它把副作用调用逐个揪出来
tagline_zh: 支付、退款、发消息、改工单、动部署——这些调用一旦超时重试就可能执行两遍。它扫你的应用和 Agent 工具代码。
tagline_en: Payments, refunds, messages, ticket and deploy calls can fire twice on retry. It scans your app and agent tool.
desc_en: Audits application and agent/tool code for consequential side-effecting operations (payments, refunds, ticket/CRM mutations, messages, infra/deployment changes) that could duplicate on retry, and helps integrate the corrobo runtime (execute/observe/reconcile) so they are safe. Use when asked to find unsafe retry assumptions, audit tool-call side effects for duplication risk, or wrap a specific mut
why_zh: 不问「有没有 try-catch」，只问「重试后这笔钱会不会再扣一次」。按副作用后果分级。
why_en: It doesn't ask whether you have try-catch; it asks whether the retry charges the card again. Severity is ranked by consequence.
limit_zh: 只审有副作用的调用，纯读接口和计算逻辑它不看；判定依赖你给出重试边界（超时、队列重投、Agent 重规划）。
limit_en: Only audits side-effecting calls; pure reads and compute are ignored. Verdicts depend on you stating retry boundaries (timeouts, queue redelivery.
title_en: Finds side-effecting calls that duplicate on retry
